title: feat(core): requires knowledge mounts the knowledge service and one vector store
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ84BSz1obpkWFoBogsxn7rAx)_

Fixes #37102

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #37310

## 维护者速读

- 应用只要声明需要"知识检索"，平台就自动装好检索服务和一个向量库，不用再手工接线。
- 用 PostgreSQL 的项目直接用同一个数据库存向量；其他数据库在项目本地放一个文件来存。
- 检索源指向了没装上的向量库时，应用照常启动，检索会明确报错并说明可选的库，不再静默返回空结果。
- 管理员在设置里填的存储地址只能落在项目数据目录内，含非法字符的地址直接拒绝，避免进程崩溃。

## What changes

- **New capability token `knowledge`** in `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS` / `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS` (provider `@objectstack/service-knowledge`, edition `open`) and in core `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS`. One catalog row in `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts`; `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md` is its `gen:skill-refs` regeneration (one row).
- **Store selection, shared by both boots** (`@objectstack/core`): `resolveKnowledgeStore` / `resolveCapabilityExtras` + `KNOWLEDGE_STORE_PROVIDERS`. PostgreSQL (driver `postgres` or a `postgres(ql)://` URL) → `KnowledgePgvectorPlugin` on the same URL; `:memory:` → in-memory turso; anything else → `KnowledgeTursoPlugin` on `.objectstack/data/knowledge.db` with `urlFromSettings`. `knowledge-memory` is never mounted.
- **`os serve`** reads the primary database it resolved and mounts the one store; an extra that cannot be imported or constructed now warns instead of being skipped silently. A host that mounts the service or a store itself keeps its own (`hasPluginMatching` on the identities).
- **`@objectstack/verify`** `constructServedProviders` takes an optional `database` (default in-memory SQLite) and mounts the same store as serve.
- **Unmounted adapter** (`service-knowledge`): service mounts, boot does not fail; at `kernel:bootstrapped` one `error` line per such source naming the mounted adapters; index and search of that source answer `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` 503 with the same message (existing code, no new error code). A multi-source search keeps the other sources' hits and names the refused one.
- **Carry from #37107 (comment 7181713320)** (`knowledge-turso`): under the token the store URL comes from settings (`knowledge.turso_url` / `turso_auth_token`). `resolveSettingsStoreUrl` holds a saved `file:` URL to the realpath'd `.objectstack/data/` (symlink escape, `..`, the directory itself and the platform DB file are refused) and refuses a NUL or other control character, all before `createClient`. `resolveStoreUrl` refuses control characters too.
- Settings manifest + 11 locales: the `turso_url` example path is now `file:./.objectstack/data/knowledge.db`.
- Docs: `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx` gains "Turning it on: `requires: ['knowledge']`"; the old "Wiring" section is now "Wiring by hand".

## Tests

- `packages/verify/src/harness.required-providers.test.ts`: `requires: ['realtime','knowledge']` on SQLite boots the service + turso (not pgvector), a record write is indexed and `search` finds it, a pgvector source is refused 503 while boot succeeds; no token → no service and `settings.getNamespace('knowledge')` rejects `SETTINGS_UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE`; host-mounted service unchanged.
- `packages/plugins/knowledge-pgvector/src/__tests__/capability-mount.live-postgres.test.ts` (new, live cell): the token's resolution on PostgreSQL picks pgvector on the same URL; a record write is indexed and `search_knowledge` finds it. Runs in CI's existing live-postgres step; skipped locally (no PostgreSQL here).
- `packages/core/src/capability-composition.test.ts`: store selection arms (pg driver/URL, other DBs, in-memory, env fallback) and extras.
- `packages/plugins/knowledge-turso/src/__tests__/plugin.test.ts`: `resolveSettingsStoreUrl` (NUL/control, inside, outside, symlink escape, platform file) and the plugin never reaching a mocked `createClient` with a refused URL.
- `packages/services/service-knowledge/src/__tests__/knowledge-service.test.ts`: boot reading, coded index/search refusals, the plugin hook.
- `packages/cli/test/serve-capability-identity.test.ts`: identity rows for the service and both stores.

## Acceptance notes

- File surface is wider than the claim: also `knowledge-turso` (settings URL guard), `service-knowledge` (unmounted-adapter behaviour), `service-settings` manifest + translations, the pgvector live test, `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts` and the generated `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md`.
- **Tier:** `dispatch-gates --tier` derives the fable floor from the generated `skills/**` row (a new token cannot land without its catalog row: `gen:skill-refs` refuses a token with no catalog line). The `spec-skill-refs` generated exception does not lift it because the same PR edits `packages/spec/scripts/`. The only hand-written text there is the one catalog description.
- `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/verify` now depend on `@objectstack/knowledge-turso`, which brings `@libsql/client` (native) into every CLI install. `driver-turso` keeps it an optional peer; if that weight matters the store could become an optional dependency with the mount warning when absent.
- Overlap with #37099 (`claude/project-thread-0g9cij` @ 36814104): shares `knowledge-rag.mdx`, `cli/package.json`, `knowledge-service.ts` and `knowledge-service-plugin.ts`; a trial merge is clean. Its after-boot first build calls `getAdapter`, which now throws the coded 503 for an unmounted adapter: the second to land should check that path.

## Verification

- Typecheck: core, cli, verify, knowledge-turso, service-knowledge, knowledge-pgvector, service-settings, spec.
- Vitest: verify required-providers (13/13), knowledge-turso (152/152), service-knowledge, core capability-composition, cli serve-capability-identity, service-settings (1523/1523).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: **partial, stopped at handoff** (about the first third of 146 run). No finding so far. Three refused on prerequisites, not on this diff: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone), `spec check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (need `pnpm build`).

## Unfinished (handoff)

- The rest of the derived gate commands, after a full `pnpm build`.
- The ceiling-tier contract review owed by `Clause-②: yes`, plus a tier decision for the generated `skills/**` catalog row (see Acceptance notes).
- The pgvector live test has only run in CI's live-postgres step, never locally.
